(a) I bought –––– umbrella because it was raining.

(b) There are –––– apples in the basket.

(c) She has –––– friends in this city.

(d) –––– student must submit the assignment.

(e) He spent –––– money on books.

(a) an 

(b) many/several/few/some/a few

(c) few/several/many/some/a few

(d) every/each

(e) some/little/a lot of/lots of/much/a little/all the

Marks distribution:

(0.5×5) = 2.5 for fillings the gaps with suitable determines.

[N.B. No marks will be awarded if there is any kind of mistake. But mistakes regarding capital and small letters can be overlooked.]

(0.5× 5) = 2.5 marks for making meaningful correct sentences with the following words.

Question 22 Not Answered

Write a paragraph on ‘Effects of Plastic Pollution on the Environment’ within 100 words.

Effects of Plastic Pollution on the Environment

Plastic pollution has become one of the most serious environmental problems in the modern world. Every year, millions of tons of plastic waste enter rivers, seas, and land, harming wildlife and ecosystems. Marine animals often mistake plastic for food, which can cause injury or death. Plastic also takes hundreds of years to decompose, making it a long-lasting threat. As it breaks down, it turns into microplastics that contaminate water and food chains. This pollution also affects human health and beauty of natural environments. To reduce this problem, we must recycle, reduce plastic use, and promote eco-friendly alternatives in daily life.

Marks Distribution:

0.5 mark for writing the title. (No marks will be awarded for writing only the title without any other content.)

01 mark for introductory remarks/topic sentence-

03 marks for writing about the effects.

0.5 mark for concluding remarks.

Instructions:

* Students must write it within a single paragraph.

If it becomes more than one paragraph, 50% of the deserved marks will be deducted.

* The response must be within 100 words. If it exceeds 100 words, 0.5 marks will be deducted from the deserved marks.

* For one or two grammatical or spelling mistakes, 0.5 mark will be deducted; for three or more such mistakes, 01 mark will be deducted.
